summary: This House Resolution expresses support for recognizing September 22-28, 2025, as "Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institutions Week" to acknowledge the contributions of these institutions and encourage their continued support.

scores.thoughts: This resolution expresses support for recognizing 'Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institutions Week' and highlights the importance of these institutions in providing educational opportunities. While it acknowledges the role of these institutions, it does not propose any changes to spending on public schools, nor does it directly allocate or reduce funding. It is a commemorative resolution, not a legislative one impacting budgets.
